observations: body L1: the head of the notes on chapter 11, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.

body L6-L7, L27-L29: the rules are checked. In the projection on the meridian (first figure), E is the point of the equator on the meridian, EO = BP = φ, so that EZ = cos φ and ZC = sin φ (sines of the radius R); HK = sin h, and the right triangles EZC and HKG are similar, so that KG = sin h sin φ / cos φ, rule (α). In the horizon, CG is the sine of the amplitude ortiva and CK = CG ∓ KG; the foot of the Sun lies at R cos h from the centre, so that sin azimuth = R (sin amplit. ortivae ± sin diff. horiz.) / cos h, rule (β), the azimuth counted from the east or west point.
body L9: the b of «Iḅn» is printed with a dot under it; kept as printed.
body L11: a small v-shaped mark stands under the space after «308,»; it is not a sign.

body L16-L25: the first figure stands at the left of lines 16 to 25, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the meridian AOBD as a circle; the horizon AB, the vertical OC, the equator ED, the parallel FI and the axis CP as straight lines; EZ and HK in dashes, each where it printed; the bold italic letters. Two specks stand to the right of OC, above H; they are not signs.

body L30-L37: the second figure stands at the right of lines 30 to 37, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the meridian AOB as a half circle; the horizon AB, the vertical OC, the equator EC, the parallel FG and the line DL through H as straight lines; the circle of altitude OHW, drawn in the print as an arc of a circle centred on the horizon (its fit as a circle is closer than as the half ellipse of the projection); HK in dashes; the bold italic letters, «aequator» set along EC and «horizon» under AB.
notes L1: the dashes of «’l-Wéfa» and «al-Bûzdjâni» measure 3.5 and 3.4 pt, as hyphens.
